work_handoff.title: N22｜People in the Flow — Ning Observational POV｜Candidate 03
requirements: Generate exactly one N22 Candidate 03 PNG and stop for Product Owner review.
Generation mode = CLEAN REGENERATION. Candidate 02 is positive lighting evidence and negative ensemble evidence only; do not use Candidate 02 as a pixel-edit base.
Primary first-glance read = Su Xiaoxiao inside a messy group flow.
Secondary second-glance discovery = Liao Jian is also present, but not as an equal co-lead.
Su Xiaoxiao is the ONLY first-glance readable named character.
Liao Jian must be visually smaller, offset in depth or lateral position, and partially interrupted by an unnamed participant or architecture where possible.
Liao Jian full frontal face is not required; side / 3/4 / partial face is preferred.
Su and Liao must NOT share the same gaze direction.
Hard rule: NO SHARED ATTENTION EVENT. N22 is not a reaction shot.
Hard rule: NO SU/LIAO DUO COMPOSITION. Do not stage them shoulder-to-shoulder, centered together, equally clear, equally large, or on the same focal plane.
Use unnamed foreground and midground participants to break direct Su/Liao pairing and create uneven depth.
REFERENCE ORDER DOES NOT EQUAL SCREEN POSITION, LEFT/RIGHT ORDER, BLOCKING ORDER OR PROMINENCE EQUALITY.
Scene remains CASTLE_ENTRANCE → INTERIOR TRANSITION ZONE.

Preserve Candidate 02 lighting gains: warm dim interior dominates; exterior doorway mostly off-frame or narrow; bright exterior region approximately ≤10–15%; no broad white daylight beam on floor; floor dark/warm/low-reflectance; wall sconces/candles are the primary visible practical light.
Architecture remains subordinate and off-axis.
No new lighting experiment and no new look reference.
Guang Yong is intentionally excluded as a readable named seed.
Wen Qingya remains intentionally deferred.
Neil, Jun Luyuan and Ning Qiushui must not become unintended hero subjects.
Unnamed participants should vary gaze, head angle, body orientation and movement phase.
exclusions: Guang Yong as intentional readable seed
Wen Qingya as intentional readable seed
Su and Liao as centered duo
Su and Liao equally clear or equally large
Su and Liao on the same focal plane
Su and Liao sharing gaze direction
shared attention or collective reaction event
bright exterior daylight dominating the frame
broad white daylight reflection across floor
